anomalies.description: A dark vehicle on the left side of the road appears to lose control and veers sharply right, colliding with or narrowly missing the orange dump truck ahead; debris is visible in the air at f1 (28.5s).

A red van on the right side of the road appears to be involved in a collision or near-collision with an orange dump truck moving leftward across the intersection; debris is visible on the wet road surface from frame f7 onward, and the van’s position shifts abruptly relative to the truck, indicating impact or evasive maneuver during heavy rain.

A red van enters from the right and moves into the lane, while a small object (likely debris or a detached part) is seen on the wet road surface near the center; the orange dump truck remains stationary or slowed, suggesting aftermath of prior impact.
